item.text: I’ll read the fixture and check every candidate start against the scheduling constraints.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open(\"input.json\")); starts=[s for s in range(d[\"window_start\"],d[\"window_end\"]-d[\"duration\"]+1) if s+d[\"duration\"]<=d[\"deadline\"] and not any(s<b and a<s+d[\"duration\"] for a,b in d[\"blackouts\"]) and all(all(any(a<=t<b for a,b in intervals) for t in range(s,s+d[\"duration\"])) for intervals in d[\"teams\"].values())]; print(json.dumps(dict(feasible_starts=starts,earliest=min(starts) if starts else None,latest=max(starts) if starts else None)))'"
